fields.description: Weekly issue featuring a front-page political column predicting/criticizing changes in Miami city government, including the resignation of Mayor-Commissioner Edward Coleman Romfh, Commissioner Harry Platt becoming city manager, and Gordon H. Russell being appointed city commissioner; includes commentary on civic power blocs and elections. Additional pieces discuss justice of the peace court practices, county constables and law enforcement, Miami publicity films and tourist promotion, a printing contract for tourist folders, Miami Beach traffic/bus safety, and various local social notes, advertisements, and a Coral Gables real estate promotional feature.
